title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 249 (Restrictions on making application under section 248)

content.overview: A company shall not apply under section 248 if, in the preceding three months, it has changed its name, shifted its registered office, disposed of property otherwise than in the ordinary course, engaged in any other activity, applied for a compromise, or been wound up.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: The bars are on a company-initiated application. They do not limit the Registrar's own power under section 248(1). An application filed in breach is void.
